name: Tonga (1862–1866)
description: A white field with a red Greek cross in the centre.
history: Flag adopted under King George Tupou I in 1862, when Tonga's first legal code was proclaimed: a red cross on white for the country's Christianity. Because it was identical to the flag of the Red Cross, adopted in 1863, it was moved into the canton of a red field in 1866, producing the present flag; the white flag with the cross survived as Tonga's jack.
